entries.content: vitest `shouldAdvanceTime: true` couples the fake clock to real wall-clock time, so `Date.now() - start` AND any executor-internal `clock.now() - startTime` measurement can exceed an explicit `advanceTimersByTime` budget under full-suite load. Use plain `vi.useFakeTimers()` for deadline-contract tests and assert via the executor's captured `meta.elapsed_ms` / outcome `elapsed_ms` rather than wall-clock reads.
